about: As a partner at Godosky & Gentile, P.C., in New York City, Robert E. Godosky brings over 36 years of experience in the legal field, dedicating his career to advocating for individuals affected by others' negligence. His practice spans:

Mr. Godosky has achieved significant victories, including multimillion-dollar verdicts such as one for the family of a disabled firefighter who tragically passed away due to hospital negligence. He is instrumental in handling the firm's medical malpractice cases and took on the role of managing attorney at Godosky & Gentile, P.C., in 1999.

A proud alumnus of Hamilton College with a B.A. in 1985, Mr. Godosky pursued his J.D. at Fordham University School of Law. He was admitted to the Connecticut Bar Association in 1988 and the New York State Bar Association in 1989, as well as the United States Court of Appeals for the 2nd Circuit and the United States District Courts for the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York.

Mr. Godosky is a respected member of the legal community, actively participating in the American Bar Association, the American Association for Justice and the New York State Trial Lawyers Association. In 2004, he joined the board of directors of the New York State Trial Lawyers Association.

Since 2011, Mr. Godosky has been recognized in The Best Lawyers in America and holds an AV Preeminent peer-review rating* through Martindale-Hubbell for his legal acumen and ethical standards. He also has a "Superb" rating on Avvo. Beyond the courtroom, he shares his insights as a dynamic speaker and author.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
